question: The average of the first five prime numbers greater than 20 is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

List the **first five prime numbers** greater than **20**: 23, 29, 31, 37, 41.

Sum = 23 + 29 + 31 + 37 + 41 = 161.

Average = 161 ÷ 5 = 32.2.

**∴ The correct answer is 32.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Prime numbers greater than 20.

**Formula Used:** Average = Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08f178eed55329455bff5739509b69a0e3ad75af9a8137e95a7b275e4c723de3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Identify the prime numbers: 23, 29, 31, 37, 41.

⇒ Sum = 23 + 29 + 31 + 37 + 41

⇒ Sum = 161

⇒ Average = 161 ÷ 5

⇒ Average = 32.2

**∴ The correct answer is 32.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Numbers

Numbers greater than 1 having exactly two factors (1 and itself). 2 is the only even prime number.

Average Properties

The average always lies between the smallest and the largest value in the data set.

Deviation Method

Average = Assumed Mean + (Sum of deviations ÷ Number of items). Useful for large numbers.</p
